note: FH.4b in-repo HTTP wrappers inferred from parameter flow, with no overlay. `api(path, opts)` hands its own `path` into fetch's template (`${API_BASE}${path}`) and its `opts` into fetch's options; `getJson` / `sendJson` forward into `api` (one level, the method fixed or forwarded through `{ method }`) and `readResource` forwards a `/v1`-prefixed path into `getJson` (two levels). Each literal call site mints the ENDPOINT the wrapper chain composes (EVIDENCE emitter `pass:inferred_wrapper`, rule `wrapper_call`), prefix folded through the const table, so it pairs the Go routes under /api. Where the FH.4a shape rule had already read a site (`getJson('/users')`, `api('/users/${id}', { method })`) without the prefix, the wrapper's reading replaces it. A non-literal, a commented call and a non-path literal mint nothing. Baseline: see the FH.4b commit. Deliberately not bound to a matrix cell: typescript/http_client is already scored.
